report: Checked all 14 candidate lemmas; every difference is licensed by the ASV's rendering or by MACULA morphology, and none is a split.

יהוה: *of Jehovah* only where the name is a construct's rectum (rule 19); bare *Jehovah* elsewhere. לְ: *unto* where the ASV writes it, unrepresented at PSA.29.2 s008 where *Worship Jehovah* writes the object bare (rule 40). הַ (assimilated): *the* at PSA.29.10 where the ASV writes it, unrepresented at PSA.29.4 s009 and PSA.29.11 where it does not (rule 12); PSA.29.4 s004 is the one-word fusion בַּכֹּחַ → *powerful*, where rule 30's article clause carries the article inside the fused unit, so it is not a third treatment.

The refrain קוֹל יְהוָה → *The voice of Jehovah* is aligned identically in vv. 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9 (supplied *The* on the construct, *of Jehovah* on the rectum). Article-on-rectum fronting is applied identically at v.3 (*The God of glory*) and v.5 (*the cedars of Lebanon*), and the article-less rectum of v.1 (*sons of the mighty*) takes its own supplied *the*, consistent with rule 29's counting.

The two `added` units (v.3 *Even*, v.10 italic *as King* in the first colon) answer to no morpheme in their clauses; no other verse folds a comparable supplied word into a neighbour, so the dump shows no added/folded split.

BSB disagreements: PSA.29.2 לַ before יהוה is the documented rule 40 convention (bare English object); PSA.29.9 suffix of כֻּלּוֹ is a judgment the verse note already records (split with suffix unrepresented vs. fusion into *everything*) — neither is an error.

Repeated notes flagged by the validator all restate contract rules (12, 14, 15, 16, 29), so no convention is recorded. Nothing here generalises beyond what the contract already says; no promotions or amendments.
